text: １ばんに　なった　ひとに　＊を　プレゼント！！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: １ばんに　なった　ひと
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase right before a noun describes it. １ばんに　なった　ひと = 'the person who came in first'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に なる means becoming something. １ばんに　なった = 'became number one'.
